[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/zoominfo-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/zoominfo-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de empresas do Zoominfo.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Zoominfo Company Data (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-zoominfo)
- **Código:** [`zoominfo.py`](zoominfo.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Company pages](results/companies.json) · [Directory pages](results/directory.json) · [FAQs data](results/faqs.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Páginas de empresas do Zoominfo
- Páginas de diretório do Zoominfo

## Funções

- `scrape_comapnies(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape company data from zoominfo company pages
- `scrape_directory(url, scrape_pagination=True)` → `List[str]`: scrape zoominfo directory pages for company page URLs
- `scrape_faqs(url)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape faqs from Zoominfo company pages

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import zoominfo


async def main():
    comapnies = await zoominfo.scrape_comapnies(
        urls=[
            "https://www.zoominfo.com/c/tesla-inc/104333869",
            "https://www.zoominfo.com/c/microsoft/24904409",
        ],
    )
    directory = await zoominfo.scrape_directory(
        url="https://www.zoominfo.com/companies-search/location-usa--california--los-angeles-industry-software",
        scrape_pagination=True,
    )
    faqs = await zoominfo.scrape_faqs(url="https://www.zoominfo.com/c/tesla-inc/104333869")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/companies.json`](results/companies.json): `companyId`, `url`, `foundingYear`, `totalFundingAmount`, `isPublic`, `name`, `pageTitle`, `logo`, `numberOfEmployees`, `fullName`, `companyIds`, `doziParsedIndustries`, `address`, `fax`, `techUsed`, `techOwned`, `description`, `fundings`, `acquisitions`, `overview`, `about`, `newsFeed`, `pic`, `scoops`, `copilotContent`, `hierarchyOrgChart`, `executives`, `ceo`, `comparablyData`, `mgtl`, `recentlyHiredPeople`, `competitors`, `employeesLikelyToEngageCounter`, `topLists`, `pageViews`, `emailPatterns`, `intents`
- [`results/faqs.json`](results/faqs.json): `question`, `answer`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`zoominfo.py`](zoominfo.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"CA"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/zoominfo-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_company_scraping`, `test_directory_scraping`, `test_faq_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
